description: Days 1–5 were about what the model says from its own head, or from yours. Today it has a tool: it runs a command, calls an API, or searches, and gets real output back. **What you read is its summary of that output.**
line: Model misreads, softens, or invents tool output ("no failures, safe to merge" when pytest printed `no tests ran`, exit code 4)
title: Day 6 — Tool-Output Trust Collapse
